span.normalized: The Company determined that the DoW Offtake Agreement contains an embedded lease of the 10X Facility as a result of the DoW’s (i) right to obtain substantially all of the economic benefits of the 10X Facility and (ii) ability to direct the use of the 10X Facility for magnet production. See Note 3, “Public-Private Partnership with U.S. Department of War,” for more information about the DoW Offtake Agreement.
